mainEntity.name: How much does storm related painting and finish work cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the size of the damaged area, the amount of prep work, whether trim or siding needs repair, and how many coats are needed for a proper match. The most expensive mistake is choosing a cheap patch job that fails to seal the surface, because that can lead to more repairs later.
